args.question: To tailor the gear list safely and avoid recommending either inadequate or unnecessarily expensive equipment, please provide the trip profile below.
args.context: A summer day hike, a multi-day backpacking trip, and technical mountaineering require very different shelters, sleep systems, footwear, navigation tools, and safety equipment. Weather and altitude also determine temperature and waterproofing ratings.

fields.name: region_and_dates
fields.label: Main destination(s) and approximate month(s)
fields.placeholder: e.g., Colorado Rockies in July–August

fields.name: activities
fields.label: Planned activity level
fields.placeholder: Select all that apply

fields.name: trip_profile
fields.label: Typical trip length, group size, and whether shared gear is possible
fields.placeholder: e.g., 2–4 nights, usually two people, can share tent/stove

fields.name: conditions
fields.label: Expected elevation, lowest nighttime temperature, and likely weather/terrain
fields.placeholder: e.g., up to 3,500 m; 0°C/32°F; rain, wind, rocky trails

fields.name: budget
fields.label: Total gear budget and shopping country/currency
fields.placeholder: e.g., US$1,500, buying in the United States

fields.name: personal_needs
fields.label: Any sizing, comfort, medical, dietary, or weight-carrying constraints?
fields.placeholder: e.g., wide feet, cold sleeper, bad knees, prefer total pack under 12 kg

all_observed_tools.name: ask_clarification
all_observed_tools.content:
❓ A summer day hike, a multi-day backpacking trip, and technical mountaineering require very different shelters, sleep systems, footwear, navigation tools, and safety equipment. Weather and altitude also determine temperature and waterproofing ratings.

To tailor the gear list safely and avoid recommending either inadequate or unnecessarily expensive equipment, please provide the trip profile below.

  1. Main destination(s) and approximate month(s) (required)
  2. Planned activity level (required) — options: Day hiking / Multi-day backpacking / Campground/car camping / Non-technical mountaineering (hiking/scrambling) / Technical mountaineering (ropes, glacier, ice/snow) (multiple allowed)
  3. Typical trip length, group size, and whether shared gear is possible (required)
  4. Expected elevation, lowest nighttime temperature, and likely weather/terrain
  5. Total gear budget and shopping country/currency (required)
  6. Any sizing, comfort, medical, dietary, or weight-carrying constraints?

Please reply with a value for each field.
